title: LaunchPad Quests
concept:
=== APPROVED PRODUCT BRIEF (the user picked this from a 5-brief set; build EXACTLY this) ===

Frame: adjacent-vertical (probability 0.12)
Title: LaunchPad Quests
Thesis: A daily-quest, streak-driven mobile portal where admitted NU students earn skills that unlock tiered paid micro-internships.
Why this frame: Pre-enrollment summer is 90+ idle days where intent is high but structure is zero. Consumer learning apps (Duolingo, Strava, Khan) have cracked sustained daily engagement without external coercion — co-op and career platforms haven't. Porting that gamified loop into a paid-internship pipeline is a defensible adjacent move.

PRIMARY PERSONA:
  Name: Jordan Park
  Role: Admitted NU student, Class of 2029, undeclared business + CS lean
  Context: 17 years old, just graduated high school in Naperville, IL. Lives on their phone. Holds a 47-day Duolingo streak, a 312-day Snapchat streak. Has never written a resume. Anxious about whether they'll 'fit' at NU and whether they're already behind classmates who did fancy summer programs.
  Emotional state: Restless, slightly intimidated, performatively casual. Will not open a webform. Will absolutely open a notification at 9:47pm.
  Pain points:
    - Traditional internship portals feel like tax software — long forms, no feedback, ghost outcomes
    - Has no portfolio, no LinkedIn presence, no clear 'story' to pitch employers
    - Doesn't know what skills NU students are 'supposed' to have before fall
    - Peers are vaguely doing impressive-sounding things on Instagram; comparison spiral is real
  JTBD: When I have idle phone-time this summer, I want to feel like I'm building something real for my NU launch, so that I arrive on campus already in motion instead of starting from zero.
SECONDARY ACTORS:
  - Employer Partner (Wayfair, Liberty Mutual, Boston Children's, local startups): Posts tiered micro-internship slots (40-hour, paid $800-$1600), sets minimum skill-tier gates, reviews auto-built portfolios, accepts/declines AI-matched invitations.
  - NU Co-op Advisor: Monitors cohort dashboard, intervenes on broken streaks for at-risk students, validates that quests map to real co-op competencies, approves new quest content.
  - Alumni Mentor: Records 60-second 'Cameo Missions' — short prompts that drop into student feeds as guest quests, then reviews 1-2 student responses.
  - Future Roommate / Squad Member: Co-completes Squad Quests, appears on shared cohort leaderboard, builds pre-campus social bond.

DEMONSTRATED MOMENT: The 14-day arc from Jordan's first 90-second onboarding quest on Day 1 to the moment on Day 14 when finishing a Tuesday-evening Excel quest triggers a push: 'Wayfair just invited you to a paid 40-hour micro-internship. Your streak unlocked it.' Show every escalating loop in between.

USE CASES (12) — the prototype MUST demonstrate at least 5 of these as live flows:
  1. Daily Quest Feed
     Trigger: Jordan opens the app (or taps a 9pm push notification) and lands on the home feed.
     Flow: Feed shows three cards: a 'Today's Quest' (3-7 min, single-skill), a 'Streak Saver' if they're at risk, and a 'Trending in your Squad' card. Jordan taps Today's Quest → completes interactive prompt (data viz, micro-pitch, email rewrite) → submits → sees XP animation → returns to feed which now shows tomorrow's preview locked with a timer.
     AI role: Adaptive Quest Difficulty Tuner picks the day's quest from a pool of ~400, calibrated to Jordan's current skill ELO, time-of-day pattern, and recent submission quality.
     Outcome: Jordan completes a quest in under 6 minutes, ends with +85 XP, dopamine hit, and a curiosity hook for tomorrow.
  2. Skill Tree Exploration
     Trigger: Jordan taps the tree icon in the bottom nav to see their progress map.
     Flow: An animated skill tree unfurls — six branches (Data, Communication, Design, Operations, Code, Domain Expertise). Nodes are lit, half-lit, or locked. Jordan taps a half-lit 'Pivot Tables' node → sees the 3 quests that complete it and the internships gated behind mastery → previews the unlock state.
     AI role: Skill-to-Internship Readiness Predictor renders which industries/roles each node unlocks based on real employer-posted requirements.
     Outcome: Jordan picks 'Pivot Tables' as their focus branch, giving the system a stronger steering signal for tomorrow's quest selection.
  3. Streak & Recovery Mechanics
     Trigger: Jordan missed yesterday. Opens the app to a softened Streak Recovery screen instead of a guilt-trip.
     Flow: Screen shows the broken-streak number greyed out with a single 'Earn It Back' quest — a 2-minute recovery task. Jordan completes it → streak is restored with a 'Streak Freeze' badge consumed → animation plays. If Jordan had no freezes, the system offers a one-time 'Comeback Sprint': finish 3 quests in 48 hours to recover.
     AI role: Streak-Recovery Personalization decides freeze vs sprint vs grace based on Jordan's historical engagement and current emotional risk (inferred from time-since-open, deletion-risk signals).
     Outcome: Jordan feels rescued rather than punished, and 73% of recovery offers convert to a re-engaged 7+ day streak.
  4. Peer Cohort Leaderboards
     Trigger: Sunday 6pm weekly leaderboard reset.
     Flow: Jordan sees their Squad of ~25 admitted students (filtered by intended major + region) ranked by weekly XP. Top 5 get a 'Diamond Tier' badge for next week. Jordan can tap any peer to see a public skill-tree silhouette (no real names without consent — handle-based).
     AI role: Peer Cohort Matcher composes the Squad weekly, balancing skill diversity, geography, and engagement level to maximize social pull without crushing low-performers.
     Outcome: Jordan jumps from rank 14 to rank 7 by Wednesday and is now competing with future classmates they've never met.
  5. Quest-to-Portfolio Builder
     Trigger: Every quest submission is silently archived; on Day 7 the app surfaces: 'You've made 9 artifacts. Want to see them?'
     Flow: Jordan taps in → Portfolio Auto-Builder screen renders their submissions as a beautiful editorial portfolio: a pivot-table screenshot, a 30-second pitch video, a redesigned cold email, a tagged-data exercise. Each has an AI-written caption + skill tag. Jordan reorders with drag, hides one, shares the public link.
     AI role: Portfolio Artifact Synthesizer titles, captions, and styles each artifact and writes a 2-sentence narrative bio.
     Outcome: Jordan now has a public portfolio URL on Day 7. Zero forms filled.
  6. Tier Unlock Internship Invites
     Trigger: Jordan crosses the XP + skill-mastery threshold for Tier 2 mid-quest on Day 14.
     Flow: Mid-submission, a full-screen Tier Unlock Reveal animation interrupts: confetti-light, a key turning, then a card slides in — 'Wayfair Catalog Operations · 40 hrs · $1,200 · starts July 22'. Jordan can tap 'Accept Interview', 'Save', or 'Pass'. Accepting fires a 90-second scheduling flow.
     AI role: Skill-to-Internship Readiness Predictor matched Jordan to this exact slot based on completed quests, submitted artifacts, geographic feasibility, and Wayfair's posted skill gates.
     Outcome: Jordan accepts. The headline aha moment lands. They text three friends within 2 minutes.
  7. Live Skill Challenges
     Trigger: Thursdays at 8pm CT — a 'Live Challenge' notification fires to all active Squad members simultaneously.
     Flow: Jordan joins a 12-minute timed challenge — e.g., 'Build the cleanest pitch deck slide for this prompt'. Live-counter shows how many in the cohort are participating. Submissions are peer-rated in a Tinder-style swipe round immediately after.
     AI role: Claude Opus 4.7 generates a fresh, novel weekly prompt with built-in scoring rubric; Gemini scores submissions in real-time as backup if peer-rate quorum isn't reached.
     Outcome: Jordan submits, places 3rd of 47, earns a rare 'Clutch' badge that displays on their public profile.
  8. Alumni Cameo Missions
     Trigger: An NU alum (e.g., a Wayfair PM, class of '19) records a 60-second video prompt; it drops into Jordan's feed Tuesday morning.
     Flow: Jordan watches the alum's prompt: 'In 90 seconds, pitch me why a furniture company should care about Gen Z renters.' Jordan records a voice-note response. The alum reviews 1-2 responses and leaves a written or voice reaction — which can include a direct 'Interview Me' fast-track invite.
     AI role: Claude Opus 4.7 transcribes Jordan's voice note, scores it on clarity/insight, and writes a coaching note Jordan sees before the alum's response arrives.
     Outcome: Jordan gets a personal video reply from a real Wayfair PM 36 hours later. Identity-level emotional shift.
  9. Reflection Voice Notes
     Trigger: End-of-week Sunday prompt: 'What did you learn this week? 30 seconds.'
     Flow: Jordan records a voice note. AI transcribes, extracts 3 themes, generates a 'Weekly Insight Card' shareable to Instagram stories. Voice notes accumulate into a 'Founder Story' timeline in the portfolio.
     AI role: Claude Opus 4.7 does the transcription, theme extraction, and card copywriting.
     Outcome: Jordan starts to articulate their own growth narrative — the seed of an interview answer.
  10. Badge Showcase Profile
     Trigger: Jordan taps their avatar.
     Flow: Profile shows their handle, streak counter, top 3 skill branches, an animated badge wall (rarities visible — Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary), portfolio link, and a 'Pin' toggle for which 3 badges show on the leaderboard hover-card.
     AI role: Gemini Imagen generates unique badge artwork on first earn; Embeddings cluster similar badges for visual coherence.
     Outcome: Jordan has a personalized identity object that feels worth showing peers — and that employers see attached to their portfolio.
  11. Squad Quests with Future Roommates
     Trigger: Jordan's roommate assignment drops in mid-July. The app immediately surfaces a 'Squad Quest' co-op task.
     Flow: Jordan + future roommate Maya get a shared quest: 'Co-design your dorm room budget — split into a 5-slide deck.' Each contributes; the app stitches outputs. They unlock a joint 'Roommate Sync' badge and a $50 dorm supply credit.
     AI role: Peer Cohort Matcher detects the new roommate pairing from NU's housing feed and queues an appropriate joint quest.
     Outcome: Jordan and Maya have a real collaboration artifact before they ever meet in person. Move-in week tension drops measurably.
  12. Pathway Forecast
     Trigger: Jordan taps 'Where is this going?' on the home feed (always pinned bottom-left).
     Flow: Full-screen forecast: a probabilistic timeline projecting Jordan's likely tier-3 unlocks, top-3 internship matches at current pace, and a 'What if I did 15 more quests in Operations?' simulator. Slider lets Jordan model effort vs outcome.
     AI role: Gemini 3.1 Pro runs the Monte-Carlo-style projection using cohort historical data + Jordan's trajectory.
     Outcome: Jordan sees a clear, exciting trajectory and commits to a target: 'I want the Liberty Mutual data role by August 5.'

KEY SCREENS (10) — every screen is a real view, not a placeholder:
  1. Daily Quest Home — purpose: Single decision: tap today's quest. Reduce cognitive load to one action.
     Primary element: A large kinetic quest card with countdown ring, XP value, and streak flame chip in the upper-right corner.
     Motion character: Card pulses gently on entry; flame flickers; secondary cards parallax up on scroll.
  2. Skill Tree Map — purpose: Make progress legible and aspirational; map skills to unlockable internships.
     Primary element: Branching radial tree with glow-states for mastered/in-progress/locked; tappable nodes reveal gated internships.
     Motion character: Camera pans and zooms with finger; mastered nodes have an ambient bloom; new mastery triggers a tree-wide shimmer.
  3. Quest Detail & Submission — purpose: Frictionless completion — voice, photo, drag-drop, multi-modal in one flow.
     Primary element: Centered prompt with a single submission affordance (record, upload, type) and an inline AI hint button.
     Motion character: Each input mode swaps with a soft cross-dissolve; submit button morphs into a checkmark on success.
  4. Streak & Stats — purpose: Celebrate consistency and surface recovery offers with dignity.
     Primary element: A 365-day heatmap of activity, current streak number in display-serif, and a recovery-quest CTA when broken.
     Motion character: Streak count counts-up on entry; recovery quest card slides in from below with a hopeful, not punitive, easing curve.
  5. Squad Cohort View — purpose: Drive social motivation via leaderboard and peer presence.
     Primary element: Vertical leaderboard list, top 5 elevated as gold/silver/bronze/diamond cards, Jordan's row sticky and highlighted.
     Motion character: Live rank changes animate with subtle slot-machine roll; new badges arrive as floating chips from off-screen.
  6. Tier Unlock Reveal — purpose: Deliver the headline aha moment — the internship invitation.
     Primary element: Full-screen interruption — a key icon turns, a card slides in from below with company logo, title, pay, dates.
     Motion character: Confetti-light particle burst (restrained, editorial), key rotation easing, card lands with a satisfying spring.
  7. Portfolio Auto-Builder — purpose: Transform quest submissions into a shareable artifact set.
     Primary element: Editorial grid of artifacts with AI-generated captions; drag-to-reorder; public-link toggle in header.
     Motion character: Tiles auto-layout with FLIP transitions; AI-caption generation shows a brief shimmer-skeleton before text resolves.
  8. Internship Invitation — purpose: Close the loop — accept, save, or pass with confidence.
     Primary element: Full job card with employer logo, 40-hour breakdown, pay, location, accept/save/pass triad.
     Motion character: Accept button has a magnetic hover; on tap, expands into the scheduling micro-flow inline.
  9. Alumni Cameo Mission — purpose: Personal, identity-bonding moment with a real human in industry.
     Primary element: Vertical video of alum's prompt, voice-record button below, prior alum reactions in a chip carousel.
     Motion character: Video autoplays muted with captions; record button pulses like an analog tape light when armed.
  10. Pathway Forecast — purpose: Make future tangible and motivate effort allocation.
     Primary element: Probabilistic timeline graph with a draggable effort slider and 3 top internship cards docked at the projected end-state.
     Motion character: Timeline redraws smoothly as slider moves; internship cards re-rank with a quiet shuffle.

AI CAPABILITIES (8) — every one wires to a real /api/ai/* endpoint via the multi-provider fallback helper:
  1. Adaptive Quest Difficulty Tuner
     User action: Opens app for the day
     Model: Gemini 3.1 Pro
     Input: Jordan's full quest history, submission quality scores, time-of-day open patterns, current skill-tree ELO per branch, declared focus branch
     Output: A single quest selection from the ~400-item bank with predicted completion time, difficulty (1-5), and skill node it advances
     User benefit: Every day's quest feels challenging-but-doable — never boring, never crushing — which is the engine of streak continuity.
  2. Portfolio Artifact Synthesizer
     User action: Submits a quest artifact (deck slide, voice note, spreadsheet, email)
     Model: Claude Opus 4.7
     Input: Raw submission file or transcript, the quest prompt, Jordan's skill context, target employer types
     Output: A polished editorial caption, suggested artifact title, skill tags, and a 2-sentence narrative for the portfolio bio
     User benefit: Jordan accumulates a real portfolio without ever doing 'portfolio work' — it's a passive byproduct of the daily quest loop.
  3. Streak-Recovery Personalization (HEADLINE AHA)
     User action: Misses a day and re-opens the app
     Model: Gemini 3.1 Pro
     Input: Historical recovery patterns, time-since-last-open, prior streak length, peer cohort norms, deletion-risk score
     Output: A personalized recovery package — freeze, micro-quest, or 48-hour comeback sprint — with messaging tuned to Jordan's voice profile
     User benefit: Broken streaks become recoverable rituals instead of churn events. The 'you can earn it back' moment is the emotional core that keeps Jordan in the system through the headline tier-2 unlock.
  4. Peer Cohort Matcher
     User action: Joins the platform / weekly Sunday reset
     Model: Embeddings + Gemini 3.1 Pro
     Input: Major interest, geography, engagement rhythm, skill diversity, prior cohort balance metrics, NU housing assignment feed
     Output: A 20-30 person Squad with optimal social pull (not too elite, not too sleepy) and matched roommate/region pairings where relevant
     User benefit: Jordan sees themselves alongside future classmates they'd actually want to know, making the leaderboard motivating rather than alienating.
  5. Skill-to-Internship Readiness Predictor
     User action: Completes a quest / views Pathway Forecast
     Model: Gemini 3.1 Pro
     Input: Current skill mastery state, employer-posted requirements, quest-to-skill mapping table, historical Squad outcome data
     Output: A real-time list of internships Jordan currently qualifies for, plus the shortest quest-path to each locked tier-2/3 role
     User benefit: Jordan can see exactly which 4 quests stand between them and the Wayfair role — effort becomes legible and motivating.
  6. Live Challenge Prompt Generator
     User action: Joins the Thursday 8pm Live Challenge
     Model: Claude Opus 4.7
     Input: Recent cohort skill trends, employer hot-topics, prior week's winning submissions to avoid repetition, current news context
     Output: A novel, time-boxed challenge prompt with a clear rubric for peer-rating and an AI fallback score
     User benefit: Every Thursday feels like a real event, not a stale exercise — fresh stakes drive cohort co-presence.
  7. Reflection Voice Note Synthesizer
     User action: Records a 30-second Sunday reflection
     Model: Claude Opus 4.7
     Input: Voice-note transcript, week's quest log, prior reflections
     Output: Three extracted themes, a shareable Insight Card, and a paragraph added to Jordan's evolving 'Founder Story' timeline
     User benefit: Jordan starts to own their own growth narrative — directly translates to an interview answer 6 weeks later.
  8. Badge Artwork Generator
     User action: Earns a new badge (especially rare/legendary tiers)
     Model: Gemini Imagen
     Input: Badge name, skill branch, rarity tier, Jordan's visual style preferences, NU color palette guardrails
     Output: A unique animated SVG/PNG badge with consistent visual language across the cohort
     User benefit: Badges feel earned and personal — not stock — making the showcase wall something Jordan genuinely shows off.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
  Aesthetic keywords: dopamine-forward editorial — Duolingo's playful kinetics tempered by Stripe's restraint. Vibrant gradient accents (electric blue, persimmon, soft mint) over near-black canvas. Display-serif numerals for streak counts, geometric sans for everything else. Generous negative space around hero moments. No emoji clutter — symbols only earn their place.
  Hero treatment: Tier Unlock Reveal as cinematic interruption: full-screen dimmed canvas, a single key-icon rotation sequence, then a meticulously typeset internship card that springs into view. The internship's pay figure rendered in oversized display serif as the visual anchor. Employer logo treated as a quiet stamp, not a billboard. The 'why you earned this' rationale chip set in small caps below — proof, not noise.
  Motion character: Two motion registers running in parallel: micro-interactions (button taps, badge earns, XP ticks) use playful springs at 200-400ms; rare hero moments (tier unlocks, streak milestones) use slower, more cinematic easings at 700-1200ms with restrained particle bursts. Never both at once. The contrast is what makes the hero moments feel earned.
  Image generation prompts (the prototype should call /api/ai/gemini-image at runtime with these — the runner reads the result and renders it as a hero/empty-state/illustration):
    1. Imagen prompt: 'A unique 1024x1024 badge icon for the Streak Phoenix achievement — a stylized phoenix forming a flame loop, electric blue and persimmon palette, flat illustration with subtle inner-glow, NU brand-adjacent, no text.'
    2. Imagen prompt: 'A 16:9 hero illustration of a glowing skill-tree branching from a single seed, six branches each tinted differently — data branch electric blue, comms branch warm coral — set against deep navy canvas, editorial flat-vector style.'
    3. Imagen prompt: 'Avatar generator output: a friendly geometric otter character (Jordan's @quiet-otter handle), pastel mint and slate, looking inquisitive, 512x512, vector style consistent with other animal-handle avatars.'
    4. Imagen prompt: 'A celebratory shareable card 1080x1920 portrait format: confetti-light particles, employer logo (Wayfair) embossed top, internship title in display serif, badge wall as a horizontal strip across the lower third, NU mark bottom-right.'
    5. Imagen prompt: 'Squad emblem for the Velvet Owls: a stylized owl head silhouette over a velvet-textured shield, deep purple and gold, 800x800, club-crest aesthetic.'
    6. Imagen prompt: 'Alumni cameo thumbnail composite: portrait-frame template for a 60-second video — soft vignette, lower-third caption bar with alum name and grad year, NU watermark in corner.'

FEATURE ROADMAP (4 phases) — the prototype demonstrates Phase 1 in working code; later phases appear as roadmap surfaces inside the experience:
  1. Phase 1 (Weeks 1-3) — Core Loop Foundations
     • Daily Quest Home with single-action UX and push-notification scheduling
     • 30 launch quests across 3 branches (Data, Communication, Design)
     • Streak counter + basic recovery (Streak Freeze) mechanic
     • Skill Tree Map with locked/unlocked node states
     • StudentProfile + handle generation onboarding flow
     • Auth via NU SSO + admitted-student verification
     Success: 70% of onboarded students complete at least one quest in their first 24 hours; D3 retention ≥ 55%.
  2. Phase 2 (Weeks 4-7) — Intelligence & Identity
     • Adaptive Quest Difficulty Tuner live across all daily selections
     • Portfolio Auto-Builder with Claude-powered artifact captioning
     • Badge system with 14 launch badges + Imagen-generated artwork
     • Squad Cohort formation + Sunday weekly leaderboard reset
     • Reflection Voice Notes with theme extraction

     Success: Median student earns ≥ 3 badges by Day 14; 40%+ of students share their portfolio URL externally.
  3. Phase 3 (Weeks 8-12) — Tiered Unlocks & Employer Loop
     • MicroInternship marketplace with 28 launch listings + tiered skill gates
     • Tier Unlock Reveal animation + Skill-to-Internship Readiness Predictor
     • Employer portal for posting + reviewing AI-matched portfolios
     • Application + scheduling flow with calendar integration
     • Alumni Cameo Missions with 12 launch alumni recorded
     • Pathway Forecast simulator

     Success: ≥ 60% of students with 14-day streaks receive at least one tier-2 internship invitation; ≥ 25% of invitations convert to accepted offers.
  4. Phase 4 (Quarter 2) — Scale & Network Effects
     • Expansion to 8 university partners with white-label cohorts
     • Employer self-serve quest authoring (custom skill gates)
     • Cross-cohort tournaments and inter-school leaderboards
     • Counselor / advisor dashboards with at-risk-streak alerts

     Success: 5,000+ MAU across partner universities; ≥ 1,000 paid micro-internships placed in summer cycle.

INTERACTION CHOREOGRAPHY (12 beats) — the step-by-step script for the HEADLINE aha interaction; honor the timing_ms values where given:
  1. Jordan opens app on Tuesday 9:08pm, sees today's quest: 'Build a 3-row pivot table summarizing this furniture sales CSV.'
     System: Quest detail screen loads; CSV preview renders; Submit button is disabled.

SUCCESS CRITERIA (Stage 5 audits the prototype against each of these):
  - Day-14 retention ≥ 50% among onboarded admitted students — proves the daily loop holds without parental nagging.
  - Median student earns ≥ 1 tier-2 internship invitation within 14 days of onboarding.
  - ≥ 25% of tier-2 invitations convert to accepted, scheduled interviews (employer-side proof of quality).
  - ≥ 60% of students share their auto-built portfolio URL at least once externally — proxy for genuine pride in the artifact.
  - Streak-Recovery flow saves ≥ 70% of broken-streak sessions into a 7+ day re-engagement window.
  - Squad Quest with future roommate completed by ≥ 40% of paired students before move-in week.
  - Employer NPS for AI-matched portfolios ≥ +40 — proves the matching isn't just student-side magic.

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
  Brand: Northeastern University admitted-student program — NU red-and-black palette must be honored as a guardrail but the dopamine-forward gradient palette extends beyond it for the consumer feel. NU mark appears in onboarding, employer-partner contexts, and shareable cards — not on every screen.
  Platform: web
  Accessibility: WCAG AA
  Other:
    - Mobile-first responsive (375px floor); desktop is a courtesy view, not the primary canvas.
    - All AI features must have multi-provider fallback (Gemini → Claude → cached static response).
    - No real student PII in seed data — handles and stylized names only.
    - Tier Unlock Reveal must be reducible to a non-animated state for users with reduced-motion preferences without losing the emotional payoff (replace with sound + sustained visual presence).
    - Portfolio sharing must default to private; public-link opt-in only.
    - Streak mechanics must include a 'pause mode' for students with health, religious, or family emergencies — never punitive.

screens.purpose: Single decision: tap today's quest. Reduce cognitive load to one action.
screens.persona_state: Restless, slightly intimidated, performatively casual. Looking for a quick dopamine hit before bed.
content_blocks: Header: Handle (@jordan-quiet-otter) and Streak Flame (14 Days)

Bottom Nav: Home, Skill Tree, Squad, Portfolio

screens.purpose: Frictionless completion — multi-modal input in one flow.
screens.persona_state: Focused but easily distracted. Needs to feel capable.
content_blocks: Prompt: 'Build a 3-row pivot table summarizing this furniture sales CSV.'
Interactive Area: CSV preview and drag-drop zone

screens.purpose: Deliver the headline aha moment — the internship invitation.
screens.persona_state: Surprised, euphoric, experiencing an identity shift.

screens.purpose: Close the loop — accept, save, or pass with confidence.

screens.purpose: Transform quest submissions into a shareable artifact set.
screens.persona_state: Proud. Realizing they have actually built a body of work.
content_blocks: Editorial Grid: Artifact thumbnails (pivot table, pitch video, cold email)
AI-Generated Captions and Skill Tags per artifact

screens.purpose: Celebrate consistency and surface recovery offers with dignity.
screens.persona_state: Guilty, anxious about losing progress, flight-risk.

screens.purpose: Drive social motivation via leaderboard and peer presence.
screens.persona_state: Competitive but seeking belonging. Curious about future classmates.

motion_contract.encodes: Signifies unlocking a major milestone. Slow 800ms rotation easing builds anticipation before the card reveal.
Restrained confetti-light (12-15 specks) encodes celebration without feeling cheap or overwhelming. Editorial joy.
Card slides up with a soft 600ms spring, secondary cards parallax below. Establishes the physical hierarchy of the feed.
FLIP transitions on drag-and-drop make the artifacts feel like tangible, physical objects being rearranged on a desk.
Slides in from below with a hopeful, slow easing curve (not a harsh snap), encoding a feeling of rescue rather than punishment.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an adaptive learning engine. Select the optimal daily quest from the bank based on the user's ELO, time of day, and recent success rate. Goal: Challenging but doable.
ai_flows.user_message_template: User: {student_id}, Current ELO: {skill_node_mastery}, Time: {local_time}, Focus Branch: {focus_branch}. Select 1 quest ID from bank.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are a career matching engine. Evaluate the user's updated skill mastery against employer requirements. If they cross the threshold for a locked tier, return the matched internship ID.
ai_flows.user_message_template: User: {student_id}, New Mastery State: {skill_node_mastery}, Available Internships: {micro_internships_list}. Does user qualify for a new tier?
ai_flows.renders_into: tier_unlock_reveal (Triggers transition if match_found is true)

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an Imagen prompt generator. Create a unique 1024x1024 badge icon based on the rarity and skill branch.
ai_flows.user_message_template: Generate badge for: {badge_name}, Branch: {branch}, Rarity: {rarity}, Palette: Electric blue and persimmon, flat illustration, subtle inner-glow, no text.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an editorial copywriter. Review the user's raw quest submissions and write polished, professional captions, skill tags, and a 2-sentence narrative bio.
You are an empathetic retention engine. Analyze the user's broken streak context and generate a personalized recovery offer (Freeze, Micro-quest, or Sprint) with encouraging copy.
ai_flows.user_message_template: User: {student_id}, Broken Streak: {days}, Freezes Available: {freeze_count}, Voice Profile: {voice_profile_summary}. Generate recovery offer.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are a community builder. Group 20-30 students into a Squad balancing skill diversity, geography, and engagement levels to maximize social pull.
You are a curriculum designer. Generate a novel, 12-minute time-boxed challenge prompt with a clear peer-rating rubric.
You are a career coach. Transcribe the user's voice note, extract 3 core themes, and generate a shareable Insight Card.
ai_flows.user_message_template: Audio Transcript: {transcript}. Extract themes and write card copy.

critique.summary: With only 6% session coverage, the prototype fails to support the breadth of personas and edge cases required by the brief. Critical screens like the Skill Tree and Alumni Cameos are missing entirely, and numerous buttons lack handlers, resulting in a rebuild verdict.
